# FutureMarketingAI (FMai)

> FMai builds Clyde, the AI colleague of your agency (Dutch: AI-collega). Clyde works in a loop per client: goals and strategy, research, a content agenda per channel, execution (Clyde creates, the team and the client approve) and reporting that feeds the next goal. 12 skills (10 live, 2 coming soon) and a memory per client. Workspace-priced model since 2026-04-28: Founding Member 997 EUR per month, lifetime rate lock, 15 workspaces included (maximum 10 founding spots), Growth 499 EUR per workspace (2 to 4 brands), Professional 399 EUR per workspace (5 to 14 brands), Enterprise 299 EUR per workspace (15 plus brands). Max 10 new partnerships per year. Data, servers and database in the EU; the language model runs by default at Anthropic (US), on request on Mistral. Application-gated: no self-service signup.

FMai is an AI marketing partnership founded by Daley for marketing agencies in the Netherlands and the EU with 5 to 20 people managing 5 to 20 client brands. Instead of isolated AI tools, FMai provides one AI colleague named Clyde who knows the goals of every client, works in every screen of the dashboard and on WhatsApp, and keeps a memory per client. Per task the agency decides what Clyde proposes first and what he may do himself and report. The agency's client gets their own dashboard, approves there, sends requests to the agency and talks to Clyde on WhatsApp. The first client is SkinClarity Club: 3 Instagram accounts, all 10 live skills switched on, and FutureMarketingAI is the agency that approves the content.

The product is not a self-serve SaaS. Every engagement starts with an application at https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply. Daley reviews personally within 48 hours. The max 10 partnerships per year constraint is honored through this gate.

Pricing canon: `fma-app/src/lib/skills.ts` revision 2026-04-28. Workspace-priced tiers recalibrated every 6 months based on observed credit usage. Existing contracts not retroactively adjusted.

Contact: hello@future-marketing.ai. Canonical domain: https://future-marketing.ai. Languages: Dutch (source of truth), English, Spanish.

## Core pages

- [Home (NL)](https://future-marketing.ai/nl): Clyde, the loop from client goal to report, the team and the client, the entrances (dashboard, WhatsApp, a mobile app in development), from post to lead, control and EU data, FAQ.
- [Memory](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/memory): How Clyde keeps a memory per client: the conversation, memories from conversations and feedback, strategy and research per client. Memories about a client belong to that agency and that client.
- [Pricing](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/pricing): Workspace-priced model. Founding Member 997 EUR per month, lifetime rate lock, monthly cancellable, 15 workspaces included, maximum 10 spots. Growth 499 EUR per workspace (2 to 4 brands, onboarding 1997 EUR). Professional 399 EUR per workspace (5 to 14 brands, onboarding 3997 EUR). Enterprise 299 EUR per workspace (15 plus brands, onboarding 5997 EUR). All workspace tiers include 800 credits per workspace per month. Tariff recalibrated every 6 months.
- [Alternatives (NL)](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/alternatives): Honest comparison with Lindy, Sintra, GoSocio and aicollegas.nl, checked 2026-10-25: what each does, its price, how it handles multiple clients and data, and when it suits an agency better than Clyde.
- [Founding Member](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/founding-member): Program of maximum 10 spots. 997 EUR per month, lifetime rate lock, monthly cancellable. 15 workspaces included, 299 EUR per extra workspace, 8000 credits per month. Cheaper than the workspace tiers from 3 brands (997 vs 1497 at Growth 499 times 3).
- [Apply](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/apply): Application form for partnership. Name, email, agency and role are required; the rest is optional. Response within 48 hours.
- [How it works](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/how-it-works): 4-week onboarding, a workspace per client, approvals and control per task, a correction loop in the first month.
- [About](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/about): Founder Daley. 10 partnerships per year cap. Why partnership over SaaS.
- [Case: SkinClarity Club](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/case-studies/skinclarity-club): Our first client, with FutureMarketingAI as the agency. 3 Instagram accounts, each in its own tone, all 10 live skills switched on, the agency approves. No result figures published yet.
- [Contact](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/contact): Simple form. For partnership inquiries use Apply instead.

## 12 Skills

- [Social Media Manager](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/social-media): Captions in brand voice, a content calendar per account, carousels in the house style and performance per post. Publishes to Instagram and LinkedIn after approval. Live.
- [Blog Factory](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/blog-factory): SEO articles from keyword research to publication after approval; length follows the search intent. Live.
- [Ad Manager](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/ad-manager): Static and video ads prepared for Meta, live only after approval, then followed per ad on conversions, ROAS and ad fatigue. Live.
- [Reel Builder](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/reel-builder): Short vertical videos with script, captions and music. Coming soon.
- [Voice Agent](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/voice-agent): AI phone calls for appointments, questions and handover to a person. Coming soon.
- [Lead Qualifier](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/lead-qualifier): Website chatbot that scores leads and sends them to your CRM via a webhook. Live.
- [Email Management](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/email-management): Gmail and Outlook inbox classification with labels and draft replies sent after approval. Live.
- [ManyChat DM](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/manychat): Instagram DMs, comments and story replies with keyword triggers, AI drafts in the brand voice and lead capture. Live.
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/reporting): A weekly report per brand, a dashboard per client refreshed daily, and an alert on strong deviations. Live.
- [SEO / GEO Analyst](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/seo-geo): Technical SEO, positions from Search Console, Core Web Vitals and AI citation monitoring. Live.
- [Research](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/research): Scheduled research per client on market, trends and competitors, with a source link per insight. Live.
- [Clyde](https://future-marketing.ai/nl/skills/clyde): The AI colleague who routes plain-language requests to the right skill, in the dashboard, on WhatsApp and on Telegram. Live.
